rows.role_title: National President of the Bharatiya Janata Party
rows.text: The General Secretary's report to the National Council session of August 27-28, 2000, headed 'M. Venkaiah Naidu', opens: 'After the National Council session of the Bharatiya Janata Party at Parivartan Nagar in Gandhingar, Gujarat on May 3 and 4, 1998, when Shri Kushabhau Thakre took over as the President of the Party from Shri Lal Krishna Advani, there have been many notable and historic events'.
